notes.title: Mousebusters is an upcoming pint-sized pixel adventure from Odencat
notes.content:
Odencat developer of Bear's Restaurant, Fishing Paradiso and Meg's Monster recently revealed their next little adventure game with Mousebusters.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/06/mousebusters-is-an-upcoming-pint-sized-pixel-adventure-from-odencat
